name: sitenotes
description: Scripts do monorepo. Cada parte mantém as próprias dependências.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend/site-notes-app ci && npm --prefix extension ci
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:extension
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run pack:extension
scripts.pack:extension: npm --prefix extension run typecheck && npm --prefix extension run build
